item.title: SpaceX Closes $60 Billion Cursor Acquisition, Merging AI Coding Tool Into SpaceXAI
item.summary: SpaceX completed its $60 billion all-stock acquisition of Cursor parent Anysphere on August 14, 2026, folding the AI code editor into SpaceXAI alongside Grok models and Grok Bot, creating a vertically integrated AI development stack.
